name: ShadyAirlines
notes: Requires navigating 4 retention screens, disabling ShadyClub Gold auto-renewal 72 hours before billing cycle, and calling customer support during business hours.

name: Amazon
notes: Multi-step Prime cancellation flow (the 'Iliad Flow' subject to FTC action) with repeated retention prompts before final confirmation.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
notes: Annual plans paid monthly incur a 50% early termination fee if canceled after 14 days.

name: New York Times
notes: Online cancellation requires clicking through multiple retention discount offers or live chat depending on billing region.

name: Planet Fitness
notes: Historically requires visiting your home club in person or sending a certified letter via postal mail in most jurisdictions.

name: Netflix
notes: Clean 2-click cancellation directly from the Account overview page with zero early termination penalties.

name: GitHub
notes: Direct self-service subscription downgrade and account deletion in user settings.

name: Spotify
notes: Direct self-service plan cancellation via Account Subscription page.

name: X (Twitter)
notes: Deactivation requires a 30-day waiting period during which logging in reactivates the account; X Premium must be canceled on the original billing platform.

name: SiriusXM
notes: Forces users through lengthy live chat or phone retention scripts before processing cancellation.
